integrity: The proof is self-contained except for the cited classical Chen–Stein inequality; numerical code is corroborative and does not certify infinite cases.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniform ternary generator entries; signature has no distinguished undefined constant; asymptotic along integer dimensions. An equivalent older algebraic statement may exist under different terminology; one relevant 1984 free-Kleene-algebra paper was available only by abstract. Poisson approximation relies on a classical dependency-graph theorem.
title: Sharp generating rank and Poisson threshold for powers of the three-valued Boolean semialgebra
